verdict.rationale: The Zoho Books API is clearly versioned: the root endpoint is https://www.zohoapis.com/books/v3 and every doc page sits under /api/v3/, with a downloadable OpenAPI corpus for that version. However, nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how version changes are communicated. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning and changelog policy, migration guidance, independent corroboration.
